jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer (Europe-based, remote) at SHERPANY
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Anywhere, Europe

Sherpany is the Swiss market leader for meeting management software. Since its founding in 2011, it has pursued the goal of creating a world in which every meeting counts. Over 400 European companies and 12,000 decision-makers are already using Sherpany with the aim of making their business relevant meetings more productive and thereby increasing corporate success. With headquarters in Zurich and 130 Sherpanees from 27 different nationalities, we are an international company with a flat hierarchy, in which you can take lot of responsibility and your ideas are always welcome.

Your mission as DevOps Engineer is to:

Work closely with your fellow DevOps Engineers with the mission to operate applications that not only provide users with stability and 24/7 availability, but also make our customer's life easier through agility and control.

You will handle generic processes such as packaging, deployments and rollbacks... as well as configuration and key management so that the team can ship even more efficiently (new) features. Due to the fast growth of the company you will evaluate the pertinence and suitability of current and past solutions since our challenges evolve rapidly.

What we will love about you:
• You are a DevOps Engineer with working knowledge on IaC (Terraform, Ansible), Kubernetes, Docker
• You have experience in CI/CD using Github Actions
• You are experienced with DevOps methodologies and have strong analytical skills
• You are a solution-oriented team player with an autonomous and proactive working style
• You have great interpersonal and communication skills in English

How you can imagine us:
• You are part of an international company with a flat hierarchy, in which you can take lot of responsibility and your ideas are always welcome
• In order to maintain your work-life balance we offer flexible working hours and remote-workin
• Your personal and professional development is important to us which is why we offer financial support for further education, trainings etc.
• Last but not least: Our corporate culture means a lot to us which is why we organize regular team events and cultivate a value-driven cooperation

Recruiting process:
• Interview with our Talent Acquisition Specialist
• Show us your skills in a Challenge
• Meet our Team Lead and the DevOps Chapter
• Meet the Team members & our VP Engineering
• Job offer 🎉

Are you ready for the challenge? 🚀 We look forward to receiving your application!

This offer from "Sherpany" has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 88.5% flex score

jobs_results.title: Azure Devops
jobs_results.description:
¿Estás abierto a asumir nuevos retos como Azure Devops en una empresa SaaS? 💥

Somos Voxel, una empresa líder mundial en el sector Turismo & Horeca que ofrecemos soluciones en facturación electrónica, pagos electrónicos y digitalización de la cadena de suministro. 💰

Como Devops Engineer, tendrás un papel crucial en nuestra nueva iniciativa estratégica para mejorar la escalabilidad de nuestra plataforma. Serás responsable de desarrollar e implementar estrategias técnicas dentro del equipo que aseguren que nuestra infraestructura esté a la altura del crecimiento constante de la empresa.

▶Buscamos un Devops Engineer altamente motivado y con experiencia en tecnologías de Azure y otros entornos similares. Deberías tener:
• Capacidad demostrada en diseñar e implementar infraestructura segura en la nube con Azure.
• Enfocarte de manera innata en soluciones basadas en la nube.
• Conocer y poseer experiencia con herramientas de análisis.
• Experiencia trabajando en entornos de alta... disponibilidad y con grandes cargas de trabajo.
• Tener una destacada habilidad de comunicación y para trabajar en equipo.
• Profundo entendimiento de componentes de la nube e infraestructura (servidores, almacenamiento, redes, datos y aplicaciones) para entregar arquitecturas y diseños completos de infraestructura en la nube.
• Experiencia en virtualización y tecnologías de contenedores, como Docker, así como en la gestión de registros privados, y en la administración y resolución de problemas con contenedores, Kubernetes y Nutanix.
• Conocimientos en arquitecturas Hub & Spoke y una profunda comprensión sobre redes.
• Experiencia en automatización utilizando herramientas como Terraform y Ansible, y en herramientas de control de versiones como Git.
• Habilidades avanzadas en administración de sistemas Linux.
• Familiaridad con prácticas de CI/CD, análisis DAST/SAST, automatización de controles de seguridad y mejores prácticas en todo el ciclo de desarrollo de software, incluyendo codificación segura, autenticación, control de acceso, monitoreo y cifrado.
• Experiencia llevando a cabo revisiones de seguridad y un profundo entendimiento de los conceptos de seguridad.
• Conocimientos y experiencia en entornos regulados como ISO 27001 y PCI DSS.
• Habilidad para influir y guiar a otros ingenieros.
• Es recomendable tener experiencia en refactorización, entornos CQRS, microservicios y Jenkins.

⚡¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido
• Somos remote friendly!
• Flexibilidad Horaria
• Seguro Médico
• 29 días de vacaciones
• Plan de Remuneración flexible
• Clases de idiomas
• Andjoy - Gympass
• Clases de Yoga y Core en nuestras oficinas
• Plataforma de Descuentos
• Servicio de Fisioterapia
• Life Coaching & psicólogos
• Referral Program
• Plan de Carrera & Formación continua
• y muchos más!

🤩¿Nuestros Valores?

#ChallengeManiacs #Fun-tasticTeamPlayers #PeopleFreaks #Changelovers

¿Te apuntas?

¡Aplica y conozcámonos! 💪

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps/SRE Engineer (Full Time, Canada & Europe)
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

As a Senior SRE/DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for keeping our product up and running, helping the development team make patches to the environment, and adjusting deployment pipelines as necessary.

You will be embedded in the engineering team and collaborating with 1-2 DevOps engineers and the Head of Infrastructure (who are based in Europe and Dubai) and providing appropriate coverage for the PST/EST time zones. At times, you maybe expected to cover an on-call schedule.

Candidate profile
• Background in Computer Science or any related field such as Mathematics & Physics
• Experience as a DevOps Engineer, SRE, or similar software engineering role
• Experience with, and advanced knowledge of, Docker
• Advanced knowledge of Amazon Web Services
• Good knowledge of Kubernetes and basic familiarity with ArgoCD
• Knowledge of version control, CI/CD, GitHub Actions
• Absolute reliability and ability to work... independently
• Fluent English communication, both written and spoken
• Problem-solving attitude, great eye for detail and collaborative team spirit

Nice to have
• Fluency in different programming languages, including Bash, Python, and Javascript
• Hands-on experience with blockchain infrastructure, from node setup to data consumption from different providers (e.g. Infura, Alchemy, etc)
• AWS Professional Certifications
• Experience with blockchain systems, bridges, and layer-2 solutions

Responsibilities
• Ramping up to the full understanding of how the product is deployed and operated
• Understanding of how the system looks when it is healthy, and the ability to trace the flow of data through the system end-to-end to find problems
• Keeping a product up and investigating downtime or deployment-related issues
• Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats
• Helping software engineers promote new releases and patches
• Working with the rest of the team on triaging and fixes of the platform, including possible over time hours in case of an emergency
• Being on-call according to a predefined schedule (daytime PST/EST hours)
• Working on ways to automate and improve development and release processes
• Willing to learn about blockchain and keep up with the field as required

This offer from "Quantstamp, Inc." has been enriched by Jobgether.com and got a 77.5% flex score

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job description:

We are hiring.

We are currently looking for a DevOps Engineer to develope and execute a Development Operations (DevSecOps) strategy to ensure quality software and infrastructure deployments and overall application health, security and performance.

You will work within the team that develops state of the art products and solutions based on Idemia technologies, with plenty of opportunities to advance your technical skills and get exposure to new technologies. You will help to deploy software components and support integration and deployment with your expertise.

Tasks:
• Define the system integration strategy and configuring, installing and validating IDEMIAs solutions that best addresses customers’ requirements and optimize IDEMIAs business value
• Build the integration environment and installs the solution or upgrades it
• Create technical documentation such as installation/configuration/maintenance procedures
• Clarify and refine requirements with Product... Owner/Business Analyst

As part of IDEMIA's Malaga team, you will:
• Define and implement architectures CI/CD (Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment) process tailored for the team’s environment
• Develop infrastructure to incorporate latest technology best practices, and improve operational performance
• Improve development, deployment and testing to make it as much automated as possible
• Support teams by sharing knowledge and best practices (including clear documents for complex integration procedures)
• Operate and debug complex integration processes and environments in autonomy
• Coache and guide less experienced DevOps/DevSecOps Engineers
• Give training and share best practices

Profile description:

Who are we looking for?

To succeed in this position, you will need the following skills:

Required:
• Master’s or equivalent degree (4+ years) in Computer Science or related discipline
• Minimum 2-3 years in software deployment in commercial software products
• OS: Linux management and administration
• Docker and Docker compose
• Intermediate verbal and written skills in English would be a plus

Desired:
• Kubernetes, Docker Swarm
• Cloud: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud
• Databases: MySQL
• Tools: JIRA, git, maven, Jenkins, Confluence
• Real passion for digital
• You’re a self-motivated individual with attention to details and strong problem-solving skills
• Good interpersonal skills

Let us know if you have an experience with:
• QA skills (Test Scenarios, Test automatization)
• Java, Spring, React
• OVA, QCOW2, Openshift
• VMWare

In addition to his/her technical abilities, the ideal candidate needs to match our community's values: at IDEMIA we are curious, trusted, caring, daring and together.

We offer:

Why should you choose IDEMIA?

By choosing to work at IDEMIA, you will join a unique tech company, offering a wide range of growth opportunities. You will contribute to a safer world, collaborating with an international and global community. We value the diversity of our teams and welcome people from all walks of life, regardless of how they look, where they come from, who they love, or what they think.

We deliver cutting edge, future proof innovation that reach the highest technological standards and we’re transforming, fast, to stay a leader in a world that’s changing fast, too.

At IDEMIA, people can develop their expertise and feel a sense of ownership and empowerment, in a global environment, as part of a company with the ambition and the ability to change the world.

In IDEMIA, Malaga, you may expect:
• Joining senior team and work with technical gurus
• Shining with your IT skills
• Using and developing exciting new technologies
• On arrival, you will benefit from an onboarding program that will allow you to quickly increase your skills
• Team building activities
• Hybrid work mode (homeoffice 3 days per week)
• Flexible working hours
• Private Medical Insurance
• Life insurance

IDEMIA. Expect the unexpected. Join the journey of a unique tech company.

Visit our website to know more about us:

www.idemia.com

Emilia Banasiak

emilia.banasiak@idemia.com

https://www.linkedin.com/in/emilia-paula-banasiak-4157496

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer Part-time (EU)
DevOps Engineer (Freelance)
jobs_results.description:
En QUANT AI LAB, seguimos creciendo para desarrollar las más avanzadas soluciones de inteligencia artificial y analíticas del mercado, siempre desde la vanguardia y unos conocimientos técnicos asentados. Unirse a QUANT AI LAB significa unirse a una aventura donde cada miembro es una parte importante de este proyecto, y cada parte resulta esencial para hacerlo realidad.

Como parte de nuestra continua apuesta por el progreso, estamos buscando reforzar nuestra división buscando perfiles de DevOps. Estamos buscando para ello uno o varios perfiles de DevOps, con al menos 3 años de experiencia demostrada en implementar y con ganas de aprender en entornos de gran nivel y proyección internacional. Estas personas se incorporarán a un equipo de élite y de grandes profesionales trabajando con algunas de las tecnologías más avanzadas del momento, y con impacto internacional.

Las funciones del puesto son:
• Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins y Groovy para garantizar una... entrega continua eficiente y confiable de las aplicaciones.
• Gestionar y mantener entornos de contenedores utilizando Docker, y participar en la orquestación de contenedores a través de Kubernetes, utilizando Helm para la gestión de charts.
• Aplicar conocimientos sólidos en arquitecturas de software, tanto en entornos de microservicios como en monolíticos, para optimizar la infraestructura y mejorar la escalabilidad y la eficiencia.
• Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo utilizando conocimientos de Java y Python para proporcionar soluciones eficientes y escalables.
• Trabajar con Amazon Web Services (AWS) y/o Microsoft Azure, para implementar y gestionar infraestructuras en la nube. Aplicar Ansible para el aprovisionamiento de infraestructura.
• Implementar y mantener prácticas de gestión de configuración utilizando Ansible para la automatización y configuración de sistemas.
• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para mejorar constantemente los procesos de desarrollo y operaciones

Las competencias y conocimientos del candidato son:

Imprescindible
• Experiencia previa demostrada en el desempeño de funciones equivalentes al menos 3 años.
• Conocimiento de Charts de Helm y Ansible.
• Conocimientos de Docker.
• Conocimientos Medios/Altos sobre DevOps, SDLC y CI/CD.
• Conocimientos Altos de Arquitectura (Microservicios, Monoliticos)
• Conocimientos Medios/Altos de Java.
• Conocimientos Medios de Python.
• Conocimientos Basicos/Medios de algún Cloud Provider (AWS y/o Azure)
• Experiencia con Groovy/Jenkins.
• Deseable experiencia con Sonarqube
• Deseable experiencia con Artifactory
• Experiencia en metodologías agiles (Scrum, Jira).

Capacidades blandas
• Altas capacidades de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita.
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo, y actitud resolutiva.
• Experiencia con metodologías Agile.

QUANT AI LAB, lo que le ofrecemos:
• Contribuir al desarrollo de una empresa internacional en continuo crecimiento y desarrollando proyectos y productos de vanguardia.
• Integrar un equipo multidisciplinar con formación profesional y académica de alto nivel, compuesto por algunos de los mayores expertos en el área de la inteligencia artificial, analítica avanzada y tratamiento del dato.
• La oportunidad de trabajar directamente con clientes de talla internacional, y algunas de las mayores compañías del país y del mundo.
• Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, emprendedor y solidario, y un equipo joven y dinámico en el que todos se apoyan para crecer juntos
• Un ambiente divertido y agradable y eventos festivos (afterworks, seminarios...).

Si crees que puedes aportar a nuestra unidad analítica de vanguardia estaremos encantados de conocerte

• Desarrollar y mantener pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Jenkins y Groovy para garantizar una... entrega continua eficiente y confiable de las aplicaciones.
• Gestionar y mantener entornos de contenedores utilizando Docker, y participar en la orquestación de contenedores a través de Kubernetes, utilizando Helm para la gestión de charts.
• Aplicar conocimientos sólidos en arquitecturas de software, tanto en entornos de microservicios como en monolíticos, para optimizar la infraestructura y mejorar la escalabilidad y la eficiencia.
• Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo utilizando conocimientos de Java y Python para proporcionar soluciones eficientes y escalables.
• Trabajar con Amazon Web Services (AWS) y/o Microsoft Azure, para implementar y gestionar infraestructuras en la nube. Aplicar Ansible para el aprovisionamiento de infraestructura.
• Implementar y mantener prácticas de gestión de configuración utilizando Ansible para la automatización y configuración de sistemas.
• Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para mejorar constantemente los procesos de desarrollo y operaciones

Las competencias y conocimientos del candidato son:

Imprescindible
• Experiencia previa demostrada en el desempeño de funciones equivalentes al menos 3 años.
• Conocimiento de Charts de Helm y Ansible.
• Conocimientos de Docker.
• Conocimientos Medios/Altos sobre DevOps, SDLC y CI/CD.
• Conocimientos Altos de Arquitectura (Microservicios, Monoliticos)
• Conocimientos Medios/Altos de Java.
• Conocimientos Medios de Python.
• Conocimientos Basicos/Medios de algún Cloud Provider (AWS y/o Azure)
• Experiencia con Groovy/Jenkins.
• Deseable experiencia con Sonarqube
• Deseable experiencia con Artifactory
• Experiencia en metodologías agiles (Scrum, Jira).

Capacidades blandas
• Altas capacidades de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita.
• Capacidad de trabajo en equipo, y actitud resolutiva.
• Experiencia con metodologías Agile.

QUANT AI LAB, lo que le ofrecemos:
• Contribuir al desarrollo de una empresa internacional en continuo crecimiento y desarrollando proyectos y productos de vanguardia.
• Integrar un equipo multidisciplinar con formación profesional y académica de alto nivel, compuesto por algunos de los mayores expertos en el área de la inteligencia artificial, analítica avanzada y tratamiento del dato.
• La oportunidad de trabajar directamente con clientes de talla internacional, y algunas de las mayores compañías del país y del mundo.
• Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, emprendedor y solidario, y un equipo joven y dinámico en el que todos se apoyan para crecer juntos
• Un ambiente divertido y agradable y eventos festivos (afterworks, seminarios...).

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (DataDog) | Remote | EMEA or LATAM
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: EMEA, Argentina

Who You Are

You excel by finding daily opportunities to grow at the same pace as the technological solutions we are developing & providing. You are Innovative and detail-oriented engineer with a passion for crafting robust and efficient solutions, adept at navigating complex challenges and leveraging cutting-edge technologies to drive project success. Likewise, you are someone who loves working in a multi-cultural environment, serving our clients and our teams, and sees feedback as an opportunity to learn and grow.  You care about the wellbeing and growth of others and yourself.

This job is perfect a dynamic engineer who thrives on tackling diverse technical challenges, enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams, and is driven to contribute your expertise in designing and implementing innovative solutions that push the boundaries of engineering excellence.

 If you want to help grow a mission-driven company... while we earn our client's trust, help our Latin America talent reach its full potential to serve the largest brands in the world, and have a major impact on a company’s future, this is an ideal role.

Who We Are

MAS means More in Spanish, so MAS Global’s name reflects our mission to create education opportunities for women and Latinos in tech, just like the scholarship ANDI- EAFIT that made our Latina Founder’s story possible, from a low-income neighborhood in Medellin to becoming top 100 Hispanic in Tech in the US.

Based in Tampa, Florida with a strong presence in Colombia, Argentina, and across LATAM, we give our clients in North America access to onshore and nearshore tech talent, to build digital pods or deliver projects to help drive innovation, from Full Stack Software Engineering and Digital/Cloud Modernization to a growing practice on Data Engineering and AI.  Our future is bright, enabled by a diverse group of experts representing 10 nationalities, fresh talent like you, and a solid foundation on decade-long Proven results with recognized corporations like Johnson Controls, JPMorgan Chase, and Dell.

MAS is a 100% Hispanic and women owned company and has been recognized with many awards and certifications, like A Great Place to Work and fastest growing company in the US.

How you will make impact

As a Senior DevOps Engineer you will be in the forefront of a platform next-gen planning and upgrading. The platform supports thousands of clients and is the glue that maintains business integrations together and in-sync. Today the platform team needs to upgrade their observability and telemetry tooling to which they need a creative and strategic thinker on how to maintain and observe the health of the whole platform in real time.

If you love to understand complex and distributed systems by the means of observability and you breath logs, metrics and events this is the perfect role for you. Your main toolkit will be next-gen platforms like Datadog with an added flavor of Containers and AWS.

You will
• Lead the assessment of migrating the company's observability solution from various tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus, Loki) to Datadog.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand current system architecture, requirements, and constraints.
• Evaluate existing observability components and workflows to identify migration challenges and opportunities.
• Develop a comprehensive migration plan outlining tasks, timelines, and dependencies.
• Provide technical expertise and guidance throughout the migration process, ensuring seamless transition and minimal disruption to operations.
• Work closely with the team to implement and execute the migration plan, addressing any issues or obstacles that arise.
• Conduct post-migration analysis to validate system functionality, performance, and reliability in the Datadog environment.
• Document migration processes, configurations, and best practices for future reference and knowledge sharing.

You have
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
• At least 4 years of experience implementing Datadog observability solutions.
• In-depth knowledge of Datadog features and capabilities, including monitoring, tracing, logging, and visualization.
• Hands-on experience with migrating and upgrading observability programs in distributed platforms from Open Source to an end-to-end vendor.
• Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and containerized environments (e.g., AWS, Kubernetes).
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional teams.
• Certifications in Datadog or related technologies are a plus.

Benefits
• English Class.
• Development: continued learning and certification reimbursement, technical development learning
• Performance bonus
• MAS Kids club
• And other special benefits.

Why you'll love working here: We believe in MAS = MORE

OUR VALUES
• ALL-IN: We are proactive, engaged agile, accountable, and with integrity.
• TOGETHER WE ARE MORE: We live in collaboration and teamwork
• STAY CURIOUS: We are innovative and life-long learners
• MAS EXPERIENCE: We live the promise that MAS is More.
• WE CARE: We care about our people, clients, community, and the planet.

At MAS Global, people from diverse backgrounds come together to make an impact and be their authentic selves. MAS Global is a woman owned business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

We are committed to the accessibility needs of applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants with a disability who require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should inform their recruiting contact upon initial connection.

jobs_results.title: DevOps QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: Europe

Job Location: Europe Remote
Job Type: Contract
Job Category: Infras & Cloud Infrastructure Testing & QA

CLICK TO APPLY

Do you have 5+ years of experience in DevOps Engineering and QA? We are looking for an EU National (due to security clearance) to join our team.

Requirements:
• 3+ years of experience in QA
• 5+ years of experience in Azure DevOps and Networking
• Knowledge of and hands-on experience in Monitoring, logging and alerting tools in Azure
• Implementing automated deployments via YAML in Azure DevOps pipelines
• Experience in Kubernetes
• Experience in Scripting (ex. PowerShell, bash)
• Experience in Infrastructure as a code knowledge (Terraform, ARM Templates, Bicep)
• Experience in operational processes (Disaster recovery, Deployments, Rollbacks)
• RedHat v8 and Overall Good Linux Skills (certified as a PLUS)
• Process modelling, Technical writing, Process management and improvement, IT Lifecycle Management... Quality Control, Process evaluations and Audits, information technology and software development methods
• Language(s): English

Desirable qualifications:
• AZ 400 – Designing and Implementing Azure DevOps Solutions
• AZ-700 – Azure Network Engineer Associate
• AZ-104 – Azure Administrator Associate
• AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
• RedHat Certified System Administrator

Job description:
• A new program is set-up to deliver a cloud transformation program for one of our key Customers in the Aerospace Industry, dealing with Air Traffic Management, Flight planning and Air Traffic Control capacity planning. You will become part of a project team which requires a mix of infrastructure & development orientated team members
• Proven all round Azure DevOps experience with infrastructure as code to deliver quality services
• provide Quality Assurance of all the code developed by Dev teams and testing before release create and implement actions, processes and controls to provide cloud platform reliability and make sure it is implemented as foundation be responsible for workload reliability while optimising the cloud consumption and taking actions to reduce cost.
• To take responsibility for the planning and carrying out of specifically defined projects relating to quality management and/or quality assurance, in order to contribute to optimising the quality within the program.
• You ensure quality management of the network management and infrastructure projects and report on the project’s quality status during its lifecycle.
• You identify and analyse needs regarding quality and initiate and execute improvement projects to ensure that the quality standards are efficiently and effectively achieved or improved.
• You determine quality standards, methods and procedures and you ensure that current quality systems are further optimised and meet requirements that are continuously becoming stricter.
• You perform complex technical quality controls on processes and regularly produce reports of the results of those controls to ensure that the quality can be guaranteed is key.
• You’ll collaborate with various stakeholders: working closely together with the development team, but also with enterprise architects, product management and engagement manager to make sure the platform meets all quality standards.
• Participate in test-driven Agile product development teams, meaning you’ll participate in daily Scrums, sprint planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
• Designing and implementing new capabilities of operating platform based on Kubernetes/Azure technologies
• Develop and document technical designs for integration and implementation of on-premises and new cloud applications and systems.
• Experience in implementing and supporting platforms with Azure
• Experience of the full life cycle of a cloud-based platform and applications from designing, through deployment to supporting and patching
• Experience of version control systems as well as building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, eg Azure DevOps, GitLab Or Jenkins
• Experience of managing automation technologies
• Experience of configuration management tools such as Ansible and Terraform

• Twitter
• Whatsapp
